subject: boeing 767-300ER
policy: Reference photographs are cited here, never committed. They are CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA works: share-alike conflicts with the CC BY 4.0 this project's assets ship under, and CC BY would require carrying the credit inside the file. This manifest records URL, author, licence and date for every one of them so the photogrammetry can be reproduced. Re-download them with `python3 refs_fetch.py "<folder>"` from the repository root; check the rule is holding with `python3 refs_fetch.py --verificar`. See NOTICE.md.

photos.author: Duncan Kirk (Flickr: 182528221@N07)
photos.view: perfil (near-pure left side profile, taxiing, clean sky background)
photos.notes: PRIMARY reference. Current indigo livery, winglets, full airframe unobstructed, Miami Intl. Tail and rear wedge crop cleanly at high res. Canon EOS R5, sharp.

photos.author: Liam Thompson (Flickr: 204089279@N06)
photos.view: perfil (left side profile on ground roll, golden-hour light, LAX)
photos.notes: Second full side profile eight days after the MIA shot; warm raking light brings out fuselage panel/door relief. Registration CC-CWY readable on rear fuselage.

photos.author: Liam Thompson (Flickr: 204089279@N06)
photos.view: rotacao (climb-out from below-left, belly, gear retracting, winglets, rear indigo wedge wrap-under)
photos.notes: Covers the belly/winglet criterion. Shows how the rear indigo wedge wraps under the fuselage and the 'BOEING 767-300ER' titles.

photos.author: Liam Thompson (Flickr: 204089279@N06)
photos.view: aproximacao (final approach, slightly low left 3/4, gear down, flaps/slats deployed)
photos.notes: In-flight view with tail fin sash and rear wedge visible; sunset light. Good for gear-door and flap-track fairing detail.

photos.author: Mark Bess (Flickr: 129713874@N03)
photos.view: lado direito (right/starboard side, touchdown JFK 13L, tire smoke)
photos.notes: Only good free RIGHT-side view: shows the starboard fin sash direction and starboard rear wedge - the LATAM fin art is not mirror-symmetric, model both sides from the correct reference.

photos.author: Charles from Port Chester, New York (Flickr)
photos.view: nariz (close-up of nose, windshield frames, radome, forward door area, from above-right)
photos.notes: GEOMETRY ONLY - aircraft still wore the old LAN livery in this photo (CC-CXJ was repainted indigo later, confirmed indigo Jan 2026 on JetPhotos). Best free close-up of the 767 nose/windshield; geometry is livery-independent. Do NOT use for paint.

photos.author: Draceane (Wikimedia Commons)
photos.view: perfil, taxiing at Lima, hazy dusk light
photos.notes: Highest-resolution free side view of any indigo LATAM 767; flat grey light. Fetch if extra window/door-position detail is needed.

photos.author: Colin Cooke Photo (Flickr: 16172980@N07)
photos.view: perfil, taxiing at Miami, crisp daylight
photos.notes: Third-best free side profile, redundant with the two CC-CWY profiles.

photos.author: Lisandro Pitowski (JetPhotos)
photos.view: 3/4 left rotation at LAX, indigo livery
photos.notes: Eyeball-only. Proves CC-CXJ now wears the indigo livery; excellent light on belly, engine pylons and rear wedge.

photos.author: Jake Oesterreich (JetPhotos)
photos.view: recent LATAM-era shot of the chosen airframe
photos.notes: Eyeball-only extra of the chosen registration; see also jetphotos 12029325, 12006909, 11967483, 11847116.

photos.author: Planespotters.net
photos.view: fleet-database page (status, history, config)
photos.notes: Airframe status Active (updated 2026-08-05); MSN 35231, LN 961, delivered Nov 2007, C20Y213 since 2020, 2x GE engines. Engine subvariant CF6-80C2B7F per airfleets.net plane-b767-35231.htm.

photos.author: Faisal Akram (Dhaka)
photos.view: head-on de verdade, azimute 0-5 graus, camera no nivel
photos.notes: REFERENCIA PRIMARIA do parabrisa (spec_763.json -> parabrisa.conferencia_render_2026-08-21). Simetria medida: os dois No.3 caem a 178.5 px do eixo dos dois lados (0.6%). Envidracado com 357 px, os seis paineis separam-se limpo no limiar. Moldura BRANCA, o que faz a mancha escura ser vidro+selo e nada mais. O envidracado do 767 e padrao de tipo, entao a companhia nao importa.

photos.author: Senior Airman Areca T. Wilson, U.S. Air Force
photos.license: Public domain (obra do governo federal dos EUA)
photos.registration: nao identificada (Boeing 767, categoria 'Boeing 767 front views' do Commons)
photos.view: head-on, azimute 0
photos.notes: Azimute perfeito, mas 6 K enganam: tremulacao de calor e teleobjetiva deixam o envidracado com ~400 px moles. Serviu para confirmar a razao altura/meia-largura (0.419) e a simetria, nao para cantos.

photos.author: Riik@mctr (Flickr riikkeary)
photos.view: quase frontal, ~10-15 graus fora do eixo e um pouco de baixo
photos.notes: O maior envidracado do conjunto (~500 px). Azimute e elevacao tiram credito da razao altura/meia-largura (da 0.435, alta), mas os contornos dos paineis e a moldura sao os mais nitidos.

photos.author: Nathan Coats (Seattle)
photos.view: frontal ~15-20 graus fora do eixo
photos.notes: A mais nitida do conjunto frontal e a unica LATAM de verdade (cargueiro). Fora do eixo demais para largura de painel; boa para a forma do conjunto.

photos.author: usuario do Commons '221.20'
photos.view: azimute 5-10 graus mas de um ponto ALTO: encurtamento vertical forte
photos.notes: Larguras horizontais e posicao do montante central medem; proporcao vertical nao. Arquivo e MPO (JPEG multi-imagem de compacta Sony); PIL e o macOS leem normal.

photos.author: Aeroprints.com
photos.view: azimute 3-8 graus, de cima
photos.notes: Mesma ressalva de elevacao da JA657J. A cheatline azul da um marcador de simetria util.

photos.author: abdallahh (Montreal)
photos.view: tres quartos dianteiro ~30-40 graus, ao nivel dos olhos e muito perto
photos.notes: Nao serve para azimute. Serve para a MOLDURA: fileiras de rebite, secao dos montantes, No.2 aberto, pivos dos limpadores. Foi ela que fixou a moldura como clara/prateada e nao preta.

photos.author: Simon Butler (Halesowen, Reino Unido)
photos.view: perfil ~85-90 graus, mas de um ponto alto de terminal
photos.notes: Contorno dos No.1/No.2/No.3 de lado. A elevacao impede calibrar z; usada so qualitativamente.

photos.author: Quintin Soloviev
photos.view: perfil 90 graus, camera no nivel
photos.notes: Perfil de manual para o contorno do nariz. O parabrisa em si tem ~190 px e esta contra sol baixo de inverno: nao mede vidro.

chosen_reason: Active airframe (planespotters, updated 2026-08-05) with the two best free-licence near-pure side profiles in the current indigo livery, both taken February 2026 (livery guaranteed current). Sister-ship photos (identical fleet livery) fill the belly/rotation, 3/4 and right-side views.

aircraft.engines: 2x GE CF6-80C2B7F (airfleets.net, uniform across all nine LATAM Chile passenger 767-316ERs)
aircraft.winglets: Aviation Partners blended winglets, retrofitted fleet-wide

parabrisa_2026-08-21: As oito frames head-on/quase-frontais e as duas de perfil acima entraram para a correcao do parabrisa. Nenhuma e da LATAM (a N534LA e LATAM Cargo): o envidracado do 767 e PADRAO DE TIPO, entao qualquer 767-300ER resolve a geometria, e o que se pede delas e azimute e nitidez, nao pintura. A medicao usada no gate esta em spec_763.json -> parabrisa.
